record.question: Which Indian journalist has won the 2018 London Press Freedom Award for courage?
record.explanation: Answer A: Swati Chaturvedi. Reporters Without Borders’ own 8 November 2018 announcement names Swati Chaturvedi as recipient of its 2018 Press Freedom Award for Courage at the London ceremony. Historical/source note: Specifically the Courage category at the 2018 RSF London awards, not every press-freedom award. Reference: https://rsf.org/en/journalists-malta-india-philippines-and-uk-honoured-reporters-without-borders-2018-press-freedom. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
